paper.title: Message-Passing Neural Quantum States for the Homogeneous Electron Gas
paper.authors: Gabriel Pescia, Jannes Nys, Jane Kim, Alessandro Lovato, Giuseppe Carleo

results.system_description: 3D homogeneous electron gas, N = 14 (7 up, 7 down), r_s = 1, simple cubic cell, Gamma point
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational Monte Carlo energy of the neural-network wave function (MP-NQS) at this N, r_s and cell, without finite-size correction or twist averaging.
results.notes: As printed (energy per electron, in Hartree). Madelung term: "const." from electron-background interaction + Ewald; consistent with Wilson (Madelung included) as WAP values agree after Ry->Ha. Boundary: periodic, Gamma (k=2pi n/L, fixed total momentum; no twist).
